subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu(Lark) Webhook URL verification fails with 401 Invalid signature when encryptKey is set

question: Should OpenClaw accept a narrow pre-signature Feishu URL-verification path for unsigned encrypted setup challenges, and what token-validation proof should be required before merge?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix intentionally changes a pre-auth webhook boundary and previous PR attempts show the token-validation layer is easy to get wrong.

options.title: Sponsor narrow decrypted-token fix
options.body: Handle only decrypted `url_verification` challenges before signature rejection, validate the decrypted token, and require regression plus redacted live callback proof.

options.title: Keep strict signature behavior
options.body: Leave webhook mode unchanged and document dispatcher mode or external workaround until maintainers are comfortable with a protocol-specific exception.

options.title: Require proof before choosing shape
options.body: Ask for official callback evidence and a proposed security design before allowing another implementation attempt.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow decrypted-token fix
recommendation.body: Handle only decrypted `url_verification` challenges before signature rejection, validate the decrypted token, and require regression plus redacted live callback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is tied to the fail-closed Feishu webhook auth behavior and adjacent hardening that the fix must preserve while adding the setup exception.
